name: Pizzería Portus Massai
title: Portus Massai: Delightful Culinary Experience on Benidorms Beachfront
description: Discover Portus Massai, your go-to restaurant in Benidorm for delicious dishes like juicy burgers, fresh salads, and savory tapas. Enjoy stunning beach views, friendly service, and affordable prices that make every meal a memorable occasion.
paragraphs: Portus Massai, located in the heart of Benidorm, is a culinary gem renowned for its delectable offerings and vibrant beach-front ambiance. This eatery features a diverse menu, showcasing everything from crispy Nuggets de pollo to rich Provolone, and savory Tostadas garnished with gourmet toppings. Patrons rave about the generous portions and reasonable prices, complemented by a careful selection of craft beers. The stunning views shared with friends over dishes like Torreznos or Empanadas impart a unique dining experience. The friendly staff and sizzle of quality ingredients make Portus Massai a must-visit destination for food lovers seeking authentic flavors near the coast.

Welcome to Portus Massai, an enchanting culinary destination nestled in the heart of Benidorm, Alicante, Spain. This vibrant eatery boasts a beach front location on Av. Vicente Llorca Alós, showcasing breathtaking views while serving up an enticing menu that caters to a variety of tastes.

At Portus Massai, the focus lies in delivering a delightful array of dishes that are perfect for sharing. Start your dining experience with their mouth-watering Torreznos at €8.40 or savor the exquisite flavors of their Carpaccio de ternera for €11.00. The menu also features classics like Nuggets de pollo con patatas, and for those with a penchant for bold flavors, the Empanada Argentina is a must-try at just €3.50.

Salads lovers will appreciate the variety, from the refreshing Capresse to the more robust Massai salad, which features a vibrant mix of greens coupled with luxurious ingredients like goat cheese and salmon for €11.00. If you’re craving something comforting, their selection of pizzas, including the Tropical (ham and pineapple) and the indecisively classic Three Cheeses, promise to delight with each bite.

What sets Portus Massai apart is not just the delectable food; it's the atmosphere that embraces diners as they enjoy their meals. Customers have described their experiences here as a lovely surprise along Poniente beach, with quick service and pleasant music enhancing the overall vibe. Popular reviews highlight the friendly staff and the overall value, proving that great food does not always need to come with a hefty price tag.
